name: Update Company
description: Update a company in HubSpot by id. Set **Object ID** and put the fields to change in **Object Properties** as HubSpot internal names (only the fields you pass are modified). Look up the id with **Search CRM** if you only have a name. Example: Object ID `123`, Object Properties `{ "phone": "555-0100", "industry": "BIOTECHNOLOGY" }`. Returns the updated company. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/companies)
